headlines: Chip/AI rout deepens: NVDA -9%, AMD -16%, MU -15%, SOXL -34.5%, QQQ -6.0%, DIA -3.2% (Stocktwits trending)
SPY 735 (-4.1%), IWM -4.1%, QQQ RSI ~29, SPY RSI ~38; extreme fear 21; breadth 6.9% oversold (Stocklake)
Gold +0.9%, TLT +0.4% as money rotates to safety
US nonfarm payrolls tomorrow 13:30 UTC (prior 29, unemployment prior 4.2); Mexico rate decision 19:00 UTC today; ADP yesterday 86 vs 90
